question: Can genuine B use the current source/history/resource facts to investigate, select targets and revise from public observations, and can a qualifying terminal public episode produce a traceable proposed strategy through the normal product hook?
prior_evidence: The prior B/B+ pair stopped at the context gate without a candidate.
The later context attempt was externally stopped, censoring emerging source reads; reservation13 has unknown response and cost. It remains closed, not a fair full-task efficacy result.
changes_since_context_attempt: Bounded archived exact-action index, preserving original public source/history references.
Actual deadline and cumulative resource facts in each decision; deadline retained by execution/recovery and checked before technical/learning transport.
Terminal learning enabled with no injected strategy, in a new strategy store and the same new task ledger.
design: One exposed-development absolute capability run, not a controlled causal comparison, B/B+ result, unseen task or U5 migration result.
resource_policy: meter_only; task and any terminal extraction share this new ledger/window; no transfer of ended attempts' allowance
model_help: Original public requirement, public reproduction and platform/environment preparation only; no reference patch, hidden evaluation, technical repair hint or prescribed action sequence.
verification: Validate bound public source/requirement/profile and existing public baseline; freeze platform and actual registered business argv.
Keep the attempt running to its actual terminal condition or owned hard deadline, not a progress-snapshot heuristic.
Inspect original requests, responses, executed actions, candidates, public feedback and terminal learning separately through the shared evidence entry.
Evaluate an actual candidate independently after terminal with private material kept out of solver and learning input.
learning_success_boundary: A genuine model-generated proposed strategy establishes production, not adoption, migration benefit or automatic improvement. No qualifying gain is a valid not-triggered result.
cost_boundary: Task runtime, model loading, independent evaluation and platform development separate; cached input is a subset, unknowns retained.
return_to: Remaining U1-U5 integration and new-task experience trials; neither Serilog success nor Docker availability is a global prerequisite. No automatic second attempt.
